notes.title: [Update] 1.3.0 Changelog - The Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Improvements

New level pack: Reset.
New dialogue in neon levels.
Extended ending.
Added extras (test levels, unused soundtracks, other stuff).
Player is rendered using metaballs.
New main menu.
Changed all cameras to orthographic.
Transition from fly mode to normal is slowed down.
Improved companion return animation.
Upwards flying speed has been increased slightly.
New intro screen.
Improved fog.
Fire now has a sound effect.
Level pack buttons are now the same gray as in the main game.
Small improvements and changes to levels.
New end credits.
Health UI is a little bit smaller.
Removed background particles.
Most of W3L6 has been remade.


Fixes

Fixed cat getting stuck in a weird position on level start.
Credits screen now takes into account the set volume.
Fixed player abilities being activated while paused.
Fix floor enemies getting stuck if hit by a player when it's trying to rise.
Fixed flippers sometimes pulling the player through them.
Fixed a jumping glitch which would cause the player to continuously fly upwards.
Fixed typos and errors in the text (the square is not a cube, a single "grey" has been replaced with "gray", etc).
Fixed player being able to jump twice as high, if both space and the up arrow are pressed at the same time. (Thanks, Jabokoe)
Fixed cat exceeding Warp 10 and going where no cat has gone before if a very specific button combination is pressed just as the game is paused.

notes.title: Anniversary Update Plans
notes.content:
I looked at the calendar a couple weeks ago and noticed that it had been almost a year since Cats are Liquid first came out. I thought it would be a cool little idea to celebrate the anniversary of CaL with a small update. Nothing too amazing, just a couple random tweaks and extras. For example…

Test levels made during development.
Unused soundtracks.
Random notes made during development.
Cat blueprints.
New sound effects for breaking dynamic objects. (Not quite sure about this one yet)
Graphical updates. (see below)

The graphical updates include denser lava fog, updated look for the magnets, extra glow particles on one-hit-kill surfaces, and the biggest change of all... The cat will be rendered using metaballs. No not meatballs. Metaballs. What are metaballs? This should explain it.

So, as I said, nothing too amazing. Just a couple small changes to make the game feel a bit more polished and some extras.

If everything goes as I've planned, the update will be released on December 7th.
